name: Vertex Securities Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1993, Vertex Securities Ltd is engaged as stock and securities broker and provides financial services[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
Company offers end-to-end online digital platform for trading in Equity and Derivatives (Futures and Options), Stock, Commodities, Currency Markets, IPOs, Mutual Funds, Insurance, NCD and Bond through mobile   and web apps. It has a network of 250 offices across India
